To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the EMI method is effective to detect loosening of bolted joints in aircraft structures and that the developed model of constrained PzT can be used for the analysis of the influence of geometrical and elastic parameters of the structure on the EMI parameters of constrained PZTs and for structural health monitoring.

1) the EMI method has a high potential for SHM of bolted joints, 2) the 2D constrained model of PZT can be used for the EMI method development for SHM of different structures, 3) the developed 2D constrained PZT model can be used for prediction of EMI parameters at different types of damages.
the developed model of constrained PZE can be successfully used for prediction of the EMI parameters in case of bolt joint looseng.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of electromechanical impedance method to the structural health monitoring of bolt jointed structure.
the development of new approach for the prediction of bolt joint looseng based on the EMI method.
a development of the EMI method for monitoring of aircraft components and structures, including bolted joints.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EMI method is very effective and sensitive for monitoring of aircraft bolted structures.
EMI technique has a great potential for SHM and diagnostics of aircraft structures and components, especially for bolt joints.
the EMI method is a promising technique for the SHM of the aircraft bolted joints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EMI method can be successfully applied for structural health monitoring in the case of bolt joint loosened in aircraft structures.
the developed model of constrained PzT and the proposed approach for EMI prediction can be used for the structural health monitoring of different types of structures.
the EMI method is a promising approach for SHM of bolted joints.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the developed 2D modal decomposition approach is a powerful tool to analyze the influence of the elastic parameters and geometrical dimensions of the constrained PZT on the properties of the constrained piezoelectrics.
the developed model can be used for EMI prediction at bolt joint loosening.
EMI method is promising for structural health monitoring (SHM) of the aircraft components.
